scope: actual-shape one-row D9 next-RMSNorm plus GGML Q8_1 activation packing

workload.control: retained D9 aggregate/tail/next-RMSNorm followed by the standalone 96-workgroup GGML Q8_1 pack
workload.candidate: byte-exact Q8_1 publication inside the retained one-block/eight-wave D9 producer

decision.result: reject and remove before runtime integration
decision.reason: The standalone pack exposes one workgroup per Q8 block. The D9 producer exposes only one block/eight waves, forcing 96 Q8 blocks through twelve serial wave rounds; saved launch and input traffic do not repay the lost block-level parallelism.
